name: Hannah
summary: The wife of Elkanah, who wept and prayed at Shiloh for a son and promised to give him to the LORD. The LORD answered with Samuel, and she kept her word.

key_moments.title: Prays for a Son at Shiloh
key_moments.description: Hannah had no children, and in great sorrow she prayed at Shiloh, vowing to give a son to the LORD all his life. Eli thought she was drunk, but then blessed her and asked God to grant her request.

key_moments.title: Giving Samuel to the LORD
key_moments.description: Hannah bore a son and named him Samuel, because she had asked him of the LORD. When he was weaned she brought him to the house of the LORD in Shiloh and gave him to the LORD.

key_moments.title: Rejoices in the LORD
key_moments.description: Hannah prayed and rejoiced in the LORD, saying no one is holy like the LORD. She praised Him for breaking the mighty and lifting up the poor.

key_moments.title: Brings Samuel a Coat Each Year
key_moments.description: Each year Hannah made Samuel a little coat and brought it when she came to offer the yearly sacrifice. The LORD visited her, and she bore three more sons and two daughters.
